comment: Known decrypted PS3 EBOOTs (EBOOT.elf), one entry per build; shared format with the other ports. Only ids and hashes. Fields: title_id, region, app_ver (the PARAM.SFO APP_VER string exactly as written, e.g. 01.14), size (bytes of the decrypted ELF), sha256 (of the whole file), status (tested = the port was built and run on it; untested = identified only), optional self_sha256 (SHA-256 of the encrypted EBOOT.BIN, a SELF; empty = not recorded), optional segment_sha256. segment_sha256 = SHA-256 over the concatenation, for every program header with p_type == 1 (PT_LOAD) and p_filesz or p_memsz non-zero, in program-header order, of: p_vaddr (8 bytes, big-endian), p_filesz (8 bytes, big-endian), p_memsz (8 bytes, big-endian), then the p_filesz segment bytes read from file offset p_offset. Nothing else is hashed (no ELF header, section headers, padding between segments or trailing bytes), so a different decrypter's layout gives the same value. 64-bit big-endian ELF: e_phoff at 0x20, e_phentsize at 0x36, e_phnum at 0x38; p_type at +0 (u32), p_flags +4 (u32), p_offset +8, p_vaddr +16, p_paddr +24 (not used), p_filesz +32, p_memsz +40, p_align +48, all big-endian 64-bit.
